endpoints.call: api for search — Jobgether 'Job Search API for developers and AI agents': GET or POST https://jobgether.com/api/v1/jobs (no API key, no signup) with keyword, jobReferences[], locations[] (country / co
endpoints.notes: from the docs / live response read on 2026-09-05

reference.limits: No key, no published rate limit. Public API 'intended for AI agents/assistants answering user job-search queries'; each job's url is the Jobgether listing page, not an external apply link; results capped at 25 per page / 10 pages. No key, no published rate limit. Terms of use and legal notices opened — no bot clause surfaced in the extracted text; robots.txt 8 rules. Jobgether's own 'Auto Apply' is a paid premium feature for its users, not an API.
mcp_sdk: https://jobgether.com/developers (OpenAPI 3.1 + llms.txt written for language models)

search.note: Job Search API 'for developers and AI agents' (OpenAPI at https://jobgether.com/openapi.json): keyword = free text; locations = 'Location slugs — country, continent, or city (e.g. "spain", "europe", "worldwide"). Unknown values return a 400 error', so pass a lowercase slug as location; page (max 10) and limit (max 25). remoteType/contractType/experience filters are not sent. Hits: id, title, company, url (the Jobgether listing page, not an external apply link), location, remote, contractType, experience, salaryRange, jobFunctions[], postedAt; pagination.hasMore only (no total), so next_page is derived from the page size. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('No API key No signup') and no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The OpenAPI lists only GET/POST /api/v1/jobs (and the /astroapi/ai/jobs.json alias); there is no single-job endpoint — url is the Jobgether listing page.
not_offered.apply: Page: Jobgether's own 'Auto Apply' is a paid premium feature for its users, not an API; listings link on to the employer.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the OpenAPI documents the job search only.

live_check.notes: upstream result sets alternate between identical requests, so py/ts first ids can differ; all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
